summary: Planned office/laboratory building on the Potrero Power Station masterplan, paired with Block 12 as a combined ~430,000 sq ft life-science campus; design under review as of the March 2025 annual compliance report, with no construction start found.

milestones.text: Blocks 11, 12 and 15 covered together at a community pre-application meeting for design review
'Blocks 11 and 12 Design Review Application' on file, referenced as the source for childcare and La Cocina PDR space designed into Block 11's ground floor
2024 annual compliance report states designs for Blocks 11 and 12 'are under review' (i.e., not yet approved) as of report submission
Developer proposes a Development Agreement amendment increasing Block 11's permitted height by 15 feet, to make its 'smaller floorplate' more attractive to commercial tenants

open_questions: No design review approval or construction-start date found for Block 11; the most recent primary source found (the 2024 annual compliance report) describes design as 'under review', not approved.

The combined 430,000 sq ft figure for Blocks 11+12 comes from the project's MEP engineer, not a Planning Department document; no Planning Commission or Planning Director approval memo for Block 11 was found to confirm or break out this figure.

The Chronicle's July 2026 report of a proposed +15 ft height increase is tied to a pending Development Agreement/Planning Code amendment (BOS Files 260724 and 260770) that had not been adopted as of this dossier's last-verified date.
